holiday_let.disqualified_actual: - Assessed under statutory criteria: actually let for {actual} days (below statutory minimum {threshold} days).
holiday_let.disqualified_status: - Status: Disqualified from Non-Domestic Rating List; transferred to Domestic Council Tax Valuation List (£0 NDR liability).
holiday_let.qualified_actual: - Assessed under statutory criteria: actually let for {actual} days (meets minimum {threshold} days).
holiday_let.qualified_status: - Status: Qualified commercial holiday let; retained on Non-Domestic Rating List.
holiday_let.default_actual: - Assessed under The Council Tax (Dwellings) (Scotland) Regs 2026 / English 140/70 day rule.
holiday_let.default_status: - Status: Qualified commercial holiday let; retained on Non-Domestic Rating List.

disqualifications.rural_unoccupied: Rural Settlement Relief: Disqualified — property is unoccupied (mandatory rural settlement relief requires qualifying occupation) [LGFA 1988 s.43(6B) / Local Government (Scotland) Act 1975 Sched 1A].
disqualifications.rural_rv_cap: Rural Settlement Relief: Disqualified — Rateable Value (£{rv}) exceeds statutory cap of {cap_str} for {cat} [{authority}].
disqualifications.rural_cat_pub_petrol: qualifying public houses / petrol filling stations
disqualifications.rural_zero_net: Rural Settlement Relief: Not applied — prior mandatory reliefs reduced net payable liability to £0.00.
disqualifications.rural_default: Rural Settlement Relief: Disqualified — statutory qualification criteria not satisfied [{authority}].
disqualifications.sbrr_unoccupied: Small Business Rate Relief: Disqualified — unoccupied property (SBRR/SBBS requires active qualifying occupation) [LGFA 1988 s.43(4B) / LGF(W)A 2024 / Local Government (Scotland) Act 1975].
disqualifications.sbrr_england_rv_cap: Small Business Rate Relief: Disqualified — Rateable Value (£{rv}) exceeds £15,000 statutory taper ceiling [LGFA 1988 s.43(4B) / S.I. 2017/411].
disqualifications.sbrr_england_zero_net: Small Business Rate Relief: Not applied — prior reliefs reduced net payable liability to £0.00.
disqualifications.sbrr_england_default: Small Business Rate Relief: Disqualified — rateable value exceeds threshold for rating list period.
disqualifications.sbrr_wales_rv_cap: Small Business Rate Relief (Wales): Disqualified — Rateable Value (£{rv}) exceeds £12,000 statutory ceiling [LGF(W)A 2024 / W.S.I. Regs].
disqualifications.sbrr_wales_zero_net: Small Business Rate Relief (Wales): Not applied — prior reliefs reduced net payable liability to £0.00.
disqualifications.sbrr_wales_default: Small Business Rate Relief (Wales): Disqualified — rateable value exceeds threshold for rating list period.
disqualifications.sbrr_scotland_rv_cap: Small Business Bonus Scheme (SBBS): Disqualified — Rateable Value (£{rv}) exceeds £20,000 statutory taper ceiling [Non-Domestic Rates (Scotland) Act 2020 / SSI 2023/45].
disqualifications.sbrr_scotland_zero_net: Small Business Bonus Scheme (SBBS): Not applied — prior reliefs reduced net payable liability to £0.00.
disqualifications.sbrr_scotland_default: Small Business Bonus Scheme (SBBS): Disqualified — rateable value exceeds threshold for rating list period.
disqualifications.rhl_unoccupied: Retail, Hospitality & Leisure Relief: Disqualified — unoccupied property (RHL requires active qualifying occupation).
disqualifications.rhl_england_2026_plus: Retail, Hospitality & Leisure: Replaced by permanent lower high-street multiplier ({rate} applied above) — temporary percentage discount ended 31 March 2026 [Non-Domestic Rating Act 2023].
disqualifications.rhl_england_zero_net: Retail, Hospitality & Leisure Relief: Not applied — 100% relief already granted by prior reliefs.
disqualifications.rhl_england_default: Retail, Hospitality & Leisure Relief: Not eligible under scheme rules for this rating period.
disqualifications.rhl_wales_petrol_excluded: Welsh Food & Drink Hospitality Relief: Disqualified — petrol filling stations (SCAT 211) are statutory exclusions under Welsh scheme rules [LGF(W)A 2024].
disqualifications.rhl_wales_zero_net: Welsh Hospitality Relief: Not applied — prior reliefs reduced net payable liability to £0.00.
disqualifications.rhl_wales_default: Welsh Hospitality Relief: Disqualified — hereditament already receives 100% small business rate relief or not qualifying.
disqualifications.rhl_scotland_rv_cap: Scottish Retail, Hospitality & Leisure Relief: Disqualified — Rateable Value (£{rv}) exceeds Scottish mainland £100,000 cap [Non-Domestic Rates (Scotland) Act 2020].
disqualifications.rhl_scotland_not_island: Scottish Retail, Hospitality & Leisure Relief: Disqualified — property is not situated on a Scottish island (100% relief restricted to islands) [Islands (Scotland) Act 2018].
disqualifications.rhl_scotland_zero_net: Scottish RHL Relief: Not applied — prior reliefs reduced net liability to £0.00.
disqualifications.rhl_scotland_default: Scottish RHL Relief: Not eligible under scheme rules for this financial year.
disqualifications.charity_unoccupied: Mandatory Charitable Relief: Disqualified — unoccupied property (mandatory 80% charitable relief requires qualifying occupation) [LGFA 1988 s.43(5) / 1962 Act s.4(2)].
disqualifications.charity_zero_net: Mandatory Charitable Relief: Not applied — prior reliefs reduced net payable liability to £0.00.
disqualifications.charity_default: Mandatory Charitable Relief: Not applied under statutory rules.
disqualifications.charity_topup_not_qualifying: Discretionary Charitable Top-Up: Disqualified — requires qualification for 80% Mandatory Charitable Relief [LGFA 1988 s.47(2)(a) / 1962 Act s.4(5)].
disqualifications.charity_topup_zero_net: Discretionary Charitable Top-Up: Not applied — net liability already reduced to £0.00.
disqualifications.charity_topup_default: Discretionary Charitable Top-Up: Disqualified — mandatory relief not active.
disqualifications.improvement_not_england: Improvement Relief (G-Factor): Disqualified — Improvement Relief applies only in England [Non-Domestic Rating Act 2023 s.1 / LGFA 1988 Sched 4ZA].
disqualifications.improvement_before_2024: Improvement Relief (G-Factor): Disqualified — Statutory relief takes effect from 1 April 2024 [Non-Domestic Rating Act 2023].
disqualifications.improvement_unoccupied: Improvement Relief (G-Factor): Disqualified — requires qualifying continuing occupation.
disqualifications.improvement_zero_net: Improvement Relief (G-Factor): Not applied — net liability already reduced to £0.00.
disqualifications.improvement_default: Improvement Relief (G-Factor): Not qualifying under statutory rules.
disqualifications.heat_network_not_england: Heat Network Exemption: Disqualified — 100% exemption applies only in England [Non-Domestic Rating Act 2023 s.2].
disqualifications.heat_network_unoccupied: Heat Network Exemption: Disqualified — requires active qualifying occupation.
disqualifications.heat_network_zero_net: Heat Network Exemption: Not applied — net liability already reduced to £0.00.
disqualifications.heat_network_default: Heat Network Exemption: Not qualifying under statutory rules.
disqualifications.public_lavatory_scotland: Public Lavatory Relief: Disqualified — 100% relief applies under Rating (Public Lavatories) Act 2021 (England and Wales only).
disqualifications.public_lavatory_unoccupied: Public Lavatory Relief: Disqualified — requires qualifying occupation.
disqualifications.public_lavatory_zero_net: Public Lavatory Relief: Not applied — net liability already reduced to £0.00.
disqualifications.public_lavatory_default: Public Lavatory Relief: Not qualifying under statutory rules.
disqualifications.renewable_energy_not_scotland: Renewable Energy Generation Relief: Disqualified — applies only in Scotland [SSI 2010/336].
disqualifications.renewable_energy_rv_cap: Renewable Energy Generation Relief: Disqualified — Rateable Value (£{rv}) exceeds Scottish £1,000,000 statutory limit [SSI 2010/336].
disqualifications.renewable_energy_unoccupied: Renewable Energy Generation Relief: Disqualified — requires qualifying occupation.
disqualifications.renewable_energy_zero_net: Renewable Energy Generation Relief: Not applied — net liability already reduced to £0.00.
disqualifications.renewable_energy_default: Renewable Energy Generation Relief: Disqualified under scheme rules.
disqualifications.telecom_unoccupied: Telecommunications Infrastructure Relief: Disqualified — requires active qualifying occupation.
disqualifications.telecom_zero_net: Telecommunications Infrastructure Relief: Not applied — net liability already reduced to £0.00.
disqualifications.telecom_default: Telecommunications Infrastructure Relief: Not qualifying under statutory rules.
disqualifications.sbbs_tr_not_scotland: SBBS Transitional Relief: Disqualified — applies only in Scotland [SSI 2023/45].
disqualifications.sbbs_tr_default: SBBS Transitional Relief: Not applicable — bill increase did not exceed statutory cap over previous year.
disqualifications.ssbr_not_england: Supporting Small Business Relief: Disqualified — applies only in England [LGFA 1988 s.47].
disqualifications.ssbr_default: Supporting Small Business Relief: Not applicable — bill increase did not exceed statutory annual cap (£600/£800) over previous financial year [LGFA 1988 s.47].
disqualifications.empty_property_expired: Empty Property Rate-Free Period: Expired — initial statutory rate-free period (3 months commercial / 6 months industrial) has elapsed [LGFA 1988 s.45 / SI 2008/386 / 1975 Act s.7A].

ENGLAND.label: England
ENGLAND.description: Statutory non-domestic rating under LGFA 1988 & NDRA 2023. Standard multiplier applies for RV > £51,000.

WALES.label: Wales
WALES.description: Devolved rating under Local Government Finance (Wales) Act 2024 & Welsh Statutory Instruments (WSI).

SCOTLAND.label: Scotland
SCOTLAND.description: Devolved rating under Non-Domestic Rates (Scotland) Act 2020. Three-tier multiplier structure and SBBS.

CORPORATE.label: Corporate Entity / Company
CORPORATE.description: A limited company (Ltd), PLC, LLP, or other incorporated commercial entity liable for non-domestic rates.

INDIVIDUAL.label: Individual / Sole Proprietor
INDIVIDUAL.description: A natural person, sole trader, or unincorporated commercial partnership.

CHARITY.label: Registered Charity
CHARITY.description: Registered charity or trustees holding property for charitable purposes, eligible for 80% mandatory relief under LGFA 1988 s.43(5).

CASC.label: Community Amateur Sports Club
CASC.description: HMRC-registered CASC eligible for 80% mandatory non-domestic rate relief under LGFA 1988 s.43(6).

LOCAL_AUTHORITY.label: Local Authority / Public Body
LOCAL_AUTHORITY.description: Billing authority, municipal council, or other statutory public body occupier.

OCCUPIED.label: Occupied Premises
OCCUPIED.description: Hereditament is actively occupied for business/commercial operations (s.43 liability).

UNOCCUPIED.label: Unoccupied / Empty
UNOCCUPIED.description: Hereditament is vacant/empty (s.45 liability applies after statutory 3-month or 6-month exemption).

PART_OCCUPIED.label: Partially Occupied
PART_OCCUPIED.description: Hereditament is temporarily partially vacant, subject to s.44A apportionment certificates.

003.label: 003 - Airport / Major Aviation Infrastructure
003.description: Airport / high-value complex requiring standard national multiplier. Explicitly excluded from small business relief.

091.label: 091 - General Offices / Commercial Premises
091.description: Standard commercial office accommodation. Entitled to 3 months 100% empty property relief.

096.label: 096 - Industrial Hereditament / Warehouse / Factory
096.description: Industrial property qualifying for 6 months 100% empty property exemption under S.I. 2008/386.

209.label: 209 - Public House / Bar / Licensed Premises
209.description: Licensed premises eligible for Retail, Hospitality & Leisure (RHL) relief schemes.

211.label: 211 - Petrol Filling Station & Forecourt
211.description: Automotive fuel sales and forecourt shop. Explicitly excluded from retail discount in Wales under 2026/27 rules.

225.label: 225 - Retail Shop / High Street Unit
225.description: Standard retail shop or store eligible for SBRR and RHL discount schemes.

249.label: 249 - Self-Catering Holiday Accommodation
249.description: Holiday let subject to statutory minimum letting criteria (minimum 70 actual days let / 140 days available in Scotland).

SBRR.label: Small Business Rate Relief
SBRR.description: 100% discount up to £12,000 RV, with linear taper up to £15,000 RV for single property occupiers (England).

WALES_SBRR.label: Small Business Rate Relief (Wales)
WALES_SBRR.description: 100% relief up to £6,000 RV, with linear taper up to £12,000 RV under LGF(W)A 2024.

SBBS.label: Small Business Bonus Scheme
SBBS.description: Scottish rating relief for small businesses up to £12,000 RV (2023-2026) or £11,500 RV (2026+).

RHL.label: Retail, Hospitality & Leisure Relief
RHL.description: Statutory sector discount (40% in England 2025/26, expired 2026/27; 15% in Wales 2026/27; 15% mainland / 100% islands in Scotland 2026/27 up to £110,000 cash cap).

CHARITY.label: Mandatory Charitable Relief
CHARITY.description: 80% mandatory relief under LGFA 1988 s.43(5) where property is used wholly or mainly for charitable purposes.

IMPROV.label: Improvement Relief (G-Factor)
IMPROV.description: 100% relief for 12 months on rateable value increases resulting from physical property improvements under NDRA 2023 (England).

EMPTY.label: Empty Property Exemption
EMPTY.description: 100% relief for initial 3 months (commercial) or 6 months (industrial) unoccupied periods under LGFA 1988 s.45.

RURAL.label: Rural Settlement Relief
RURAL.description: 100% mandatory relief for sole general stores, food shops, or post offices in designated rural settlements.

LAVATORY.label: Public Lavatories Relief
LAVATORY.description: 100% statutory rating exemption under Rating (Coronavirus and Public Lavatories) Act 2021.

HEAT_NET.label: Heat Network Relief
HEAT_NET.description: 100% relief for low-carbon district heating distribution hereditaments under NDRA 2023 (England).

WELSH_AVOIDANCE.label: Anti-Avoidance Statutory Penalty
WELSH_AVOIDANCE.description: Statutory penalty under Welsh Statutory Instrument 2026/43 (£500 fixed + 3% rateable value) for artificial avoidance.

SBBS_TR.label: Small Business Bonus Scheme Transitional Relief
SBBS_TR.description: Scottish statutory protection capping net bill increases for properties losing or seeing reduced SBBS (£600 in 2023/24 to £1,800 in 2025/26; 25% bill increase limit in 2026/27).

SSBR.label: Supporting Small Business Relief
SSBR.description: English statutory protection capping net bill increases for properties losing or seeing reduced SBRR, rural rate relief, or RHL relief (£600 annual increase cap in 2023–2025; £800 annual increase cap in 2026/27).

WALES_TR.label: Welsh Transitional Relief
WALES_TR.description: Statutory two-year transitional phasing scheme under W.S.I. 2025/1371 / W.S.I. 2022/1350 (67% relief on bill increases > £300 in Year 1, 34% in Year 2).

TELECOM.label: Telecommunications Infrastructure Relief
TELECOM.description: 100% statutory relief for new fibre telecommunications infrastructure under Telecommunications Infrastructure Act 2018 / SSI 2019/111.

CHARITY_TOPUP.label: Discretionary Charitable Relief Top-Up
CHARITY_TOPUP.description: Up to 20% discretionary top-up relief by billing authorities under LGFA 1988 s.47(2)(a) / 1962 Act s.4(5).

RENEWABLE.label: Renewable Energy Generation Relief
RENEWABLE.description: Tiered relief for renewable energy generation hereditaments under SSI 2010/336 (100% up to £145k RV, scaling to 10% up to £1m RV).

COUNCIL_TAX_TRANSFER.label: Council Tax Transfer (Holiday Let Disqualification)
COUNCIL_TAX_TRANSFER.description: Disqualification from non-domestic rating list where self-catering accommodation fails statutory actual letting days threshold (182 days Scotland, 70 days England/Wales).

SMALL_BUSINESS.label: Small Business Multiplier
SMALL_BUSINESS.description: Reduced multiplier for qualifying small businesses.

HIGH_VALUE.label: High-Value Multiplier
HIGH_VALUE.description: Higher rating multiplier for high-value properties (e.g. RV >= £500,000 in England).

SMALL_BUSINESS_RHL.label: Small Business RHL Multiplier
SMALL_BUSINESS_RHL.description: Permanent reduced multiplier for qualifying retail, hospitality, leisure under £51k RV in England.

STANDARD_RHL.label: Standard RHL Multiplier
STANDARD_RHL.description: Permanent reduced multiplier for qualifying retail, hospitality, leisure £51k-£500k RV in England.

RETAIL.label: Welsh Retail Multiplier
RETAIL.description: Lower statutory multiplier for small retail premises under £51k RV in Wales under LGF(W)A 2024 (35.0p in 2026/27).

HIGHER.label: Higher Multiplier (Wales)
HIGHER.description: Higher statutory multiplier for properties exceeding £100k RV in Wales under LGF(W)A 2024 (51.5p in 2026/27).
